newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ hotel occupancy rises to 62.8 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: NZ hotel occupancy rises to 62.8 pct in November.

text.p: New Zealand hotel occupancy rose to 62.8 percent in November, a climb of 9.6 percentage points, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
The overall occupancy rate, based on a survey of 2,884 accommodation establishments, was 34.8 percent, the highest level since the survey began in July 1996.

Accommodation occupancy excluding caravan parks and campgrounds was 58.6 percent for November 1996, up from 50.0 percent in October and 47.4 percent in September. The rate for caravan parks/campgrounds was 9.5 percent.
Auckland had the highest occupancy rate, at 58.4 percent, a rise of 8.2 percentage points. Wellington and Canterbury recorded 56.9 percent and 40.8 percent respectively.
The average length of stay at accommodation establishments in November was 1.8 nights, and the number of guest nights increased by 14.7 percent compared to October.
